rationale: The workflow already implements the evidence-supported dependency-caching optimization: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 is present in every Rust job (check-wasm, check-workspace, unit-tests, simnet-tests, ethereum-tests, bsc-tests, tendermint-tests, pharos-tests), and setup-node uses cache: pnpm with a lockfile dependency path, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already satisfied rather than being a new change. concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true already cancels superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not safely applicable: ci_history contains no run durations, so there is no representative successful-duration history to set a limit, and adding a timeout risks killing valid slow runs such as simnet-tests (release build plus simnode). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST on the check-wasm matrix is not safe because required_checks are unverified and full matrix diagnostics may be required. Scheduled-workflow patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) do not apply because the workflow has no schedule trigger. Test/build selection patterns require a separately approved selection treatment and verified required checks, which are absent. No new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or publishing/deployment operations are introduced.
